name: qt-cpp
description: Qt item models written in C++, proved by fixtures - item-model-contract-testing (a view mirror built from signals only, QAbstractItemModelTester in Fatal mode, a seeded random driver against a plain reference, selection and persistent-index survival, a sorting proxy, deliberately wrong adapters as controls), container-to-model-patterns (begin and end paired once in one base, a row index per container order, ranges as one change, edits through the container, one-thread rule, nothrow move), qt-build-traps (dependent-base connect, slots and signals macros, template commas in a test macro, normalized class names, two-unit -Wodr builds, Q_OBJECT in a template) and qml-types-from-cpp - with a text lint for unpaired begin and end calls, a row used as a key, an unqualified connect in a template and boxing at an emit, an advisory PostToolUse hook that runs it, and Qt 6 fixtures built with CMake AUTOMOC and the system compiler.
